entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person facing away from the camera, wearing a bulky white extravehicular suit, carrying a large white rectangular backpack and side frames, with both legs and the soles of the boots oriented toward the camera.

entities.name: black outer-space background
entities.identification: A large expanse of deep-black background outside the outline of the module, extending mainly along the image-left side.

entities.name: gold foil-covered equipment assembly
entities.identification: An equipment area to the image-right of and behind Person A, consisting of box-shaped modules covered with reflective gold foil, dark brackets, and thin handrails.

entities.name: gray exterior bulkhead and frame
entities.identification: Large gray panel surfaces, seams, edge rails, and a dark frame extending into the image-right-lower foreground around the person and equipment.
